messages:
lina: FYI customer Acero sent an invoice vs dashboard gap. Invoice shows ~2.7M embed units, UI shows ~900k. They attached request IDs and claim no intentional retries. Can we triage?

micah: thanks — can you drop the example request + any idempotency keys they used?

lina: pasted below (redacted keys). note: they batch variable-length texts and sometimes send empty strings between docs.

lina: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -H "Idempotency-Key: 0a7f-xxxx-yy" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-small","input": ["doc1", "", "doc3", "... repeated ..."]}'
```

sana: hypothesis: partial-batch retries + missing idempotency handling in the async batch path could cause double-counting. Also saw an edge-case where empty-string inputs are collapsed and cause dimension-fallback to 0-vector on one path but counted as full vector on billing metrics.

ava: can you paste invoice id and a couple request ids to correlate?

lina: invoice: INV-2026-ACERO-09, request ids: rq_01F8X1, rq_01F8X2, rq_01F8X2-retry. Customer forwarded server responses showing 200 but then later 500 on the same batch.

micah: checking infra logs for that window. quick note: we had a GPU pool restart in eu-west around 1938449000 which caused in-flight streaming connections to close. Clients that retried without idempotency could have re-submitted entire batches. :eyes:

ops-escalations-bot: automated note: potential duplication window detected 1938448000–1938460000 for pool gpu-pool-eu-west.

lina: here are runtime logs from customer-sent dump (sanitized):

lina: ```
[2026-11-24T05:41:22Z] pool-eu-west chunk 0 processed, billing_counted=1024 request_id=rq_01F8X2
[2026-11-24T05:41:23Z] pool-eu-west client connection reset, retrying without idempotency request_id=rq_01F8X2
[2026-11-24T05:41:24Z] pool-eu-west chunk 0 processed, billing_counted=1024 request_id=rq_01F8X2-retry
```

sana: that log pattern is the smoking gun — billing increments on chunk success and the retry created a second successful chunk. We should only increment on final-ack or ensure idempotency keys are used to dedupe billing increments.

ava: can ops export the raw billing events for INV-2026-ACERO-09 so we can reconcile counted vectors vs accepted responses? Need the event_ids for the 1938448–1938460 window.

micah: already pulling the replayer trace. I can run a local replay using the customer's payload + simulate connection reset to reproduce. use this command to repro locally: 

micah: ```
./replayer --input payload.json --simulate-reset-at 1 --idempotency "none" --region eu-west
```

lina: ran repro, saw the same double-count in the test environment. Output: billed_units=2048 but only 1024 unique inputs.

billing-bot: invoice snapshot INV-2026-ACERO-09 shows event_window_dup_flag=true for window 1938448000-1938460000.

sana: short-term mitigation: billing team can apply a reconciliation script to dedupe events by request id + chunk index where present, then issue a credit for the delta. Long term: runtime fix to atomically commit billing counters only after final aggregation and persist idempotency keys for chunk-level retries.

ava: agree. please send the list of affected request ids and the delta amount. finance will review credits. :+1:

micah: I'll open a runtime PR titled "billing: ensure idempotent billing increments for async batch retries" — plan is to 1) use persisted idempotency key for chunk-level ops, 2) mark billing events as tentative until final ack, 3) add server-side metric to detect >1 success for same (idempotency_key, chunk_index).

lina: customer outreach: I'll propose a provisional credit and ask for any missing idempotency headers on their side while we fix the server.

sana: adding one more edge-case: empty-string inputs sometimes lead to 0-dim fallback on older quantized kernels. We'll patch the embed pipeline to normalize empty inputs to a deterministic vector before billing.

lina: next steps checklist: 
- micah: run replayer across full window and attach trace (ETA 2h)
- ava: export billing events & calculate delta (ETA 3h)
- sana: prepare runtime patch & test (ETA EOD)
- lina: send customer note + provisional credit offer (ETA 1h)

micah: started replay job, putting trace in #eng-runtime when complete.

ava: noted, creating a credit hold in the billing system until we confirm reconciliation.

lina: thanks all — keeping customer looped in. :wave:
